industry.title: Industry Calculator
industry.productionGoalsHint: Click the icon to choose the resource. Add multiple rows to calculate combined chains.
industry.quarryNoVehicleOrPersonnel: This quarry has no excavator or workforce. It produces nothing. Add vehicles or enable workforce to produce.
industry.waterLivestockWarning: The displayed water consumption does not include water for stored livestock (~0.05 m³/t of livestock).

settings.title: Settings
settings.sourceQualityHint: Source quality represents deposit richness (0-100%). It affects production of mines: rawbauxite, rawgravel, rawiron, rawcoal, uranium, oil.
settings.sourceQualityExample: Example: A mine at 50% quality will produce 50% of its maximum output.
settings.defaultYearHint: Year affects electronic components and electronic appliances recipes: production decreases and consumption increases over the years.
settings.defaultVehicleHint: Vehicle used by default for rawgravel and rawbauxite quarries. Click the image to choose another.
settings.defaultVehicleNote: Quarries can run without any workforce if they have at least one vehicle.
settings.defaultBuildingHint: When a resource can be produced by several buildings, the default building used in the production calculator. Click the image to choose another.
settings.pollutionDistanceModeHint: Safety distances were manually measured for each building. The factory runs at 100% capacity; water pump stations serve as indicators (their source quality reflects the ambient pollution level). On each of the four sides of the building, two pumps are placed: one at 80% life quality and one at 95%. The distance between the building center and each pump is measured. All four sides are measured because pollution does not spread uniformly. The slider offers 6 levels: from the minimum observed distance at 80% quality up to the maximum observed distance at 95%.
settings.pollutionDistanceModeHintConfiant: Minimum distance (80% quality). Best for space efficiency, accepting that some areas may be slightly exposed.
settings.pollutionDistanceModeHintPrudent: Maximum distance (95% quality). Ensures your population is completely protected from pollution at all times.
